rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: OAuth 2.0 authorization gateway that handles client authentication via PKCE and proxies requests to multiple configured upstream MCP servers. Exposes meta-tools for managing a personal MCP toolbox including listing, adding, removing servers, and calling tools through a unified gateway endpoint. Supports credit-based tool gating and multi-client isolation via Supabase.
